constellations.summary: Premier ATK buffer and rapid healer in Genshin Impact.
Grand Expectation's ATK increase no longer has an HP restriction and gains an additional 20% of Bennett's Base ATK.
Increases Elemental Burst level by 3 (directly raises ATK buff ratio).
Grants +15% Pyro DMG and Pyro infusion to sword/claymore/polearm characters inside his Inspiration Field.
